subject.title: Feature request: MEMORY.md size warning/limit enforcement

question: Should OpenClaw add core Control UI save-time MEMORY.md budget enforcement and an archive workflow, or fold the remaining behavior into the broader bounded-memory design?
rationale: Current main already warns and diagnoses bootstrap truncation, but the remaining request changes workspace-file editing and memory lifecycle behavior rather than repairing one missed code path.

options.title: Define a narrow core UX contract
options.body: Add a Control UI budget display and explicit save-time warning or block for bootstrap files, while leaving auto-archive to separate memory design work.

options.title: Fold into bounded memory work
options.body: Track hard limits and archive behavior under #42877 and treat this issue as the MEMORY.md UI case once maintainers confirm that direction.

options.title: Keep diagnostics only
options.body: Declare prompt, doctor, and /context diagnostics sufficient for now and close the UI/save-enforcement request after maintainer confirmation.

recommendation.title: Define a narrow core UX contract
recommendation.body: Add a Control UI budget display and explicit save-time warning or block for bootstrap files, while leaving auto-archive to separate memory design work.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest combined history on bootstrap truncation handling and the Agents dashboard/file editing surface.
